coordination_protocol.exchange_format: Structured evidence records containing claim, source URL, publisher, publication time, event time, retrieval time, source independence, confidence, disagreement, and disconfirming evidence.
coordination_protocol.consensus_rule: Resolve disagreements using primary-source evidence and reproducible measurements; retain minority objections.
coordination_protocol.red_team_rule: Challenge leakage, survivorship bias, stale data, venue coverage overlap, hidden financing assumptions, and causal overclaim.
coordination_protocol.least_privilege: Grant only task-scoped access when a provider is explicitly connected; prefer public read-only sources and local deterministic fallbacks.
